rationale: The approved portrait lamp-placement interaction enters from a canvas-locked rod or ground target and keeps the preview at the top. A single tap places an unplaced lamp or withdraws a lamp only from the current target; a cross-target tap preserves its source position and explains where to withdraw it without a shifting inline notice. A double tap toggles only the address mark. Placed lamps use solid group color with readable source text; earlier digests are retained for audit.
